items.title: Pokémon Center Confirms Data Breach – Hackers Stole Customers’ Personal Data
items.description: Pokémon Center has begun notifying customers in the United Kingdom and Germany that their personal information was exposed in a third-party data breach, and that the incident has forced the company to cancel a batch of pending orders.
